title: Technology Research Institute, Wuhan Textile University
content:
The Technology Research Institute of Wuhan Textile University in Wuhan, Hubei Province, is an applied research unit focused on fiber science and advanced textile materials, supporting the university's textile science and engineering programs.

Research groups affiliated with the institute work on nanofiber aerogels, including cellulose, silk nanofiber and other biomass-derived aerogels for thermal insulation, air filtration and water treatment, as well as aerogel fibers inspired by polar bear hair for lightweight thermal textiles.

The institute collaborates with industry and academic partners to move fibrous and aerogel materials from laboratory synthesis toward pilot-scale production.
